families.finding: Neither proposed reading states what happens to the reader; both stay on the sector.
The series measures production, and no reading turns that into a gain for anybody.
Nothing proposed puts a person or a place into a statistical series.
No proposed reading names a cause of the production figure.
The supplier reading is a step out from the measured population, and the series itself says the population is producers.
The contractor reading states a future, which is what proposal 2 does and what its own strength claims.
The material carries no inspection or compliance figure at all, so a reading about the weight of them has nothing behind it.

tempting.temptation_note: A record production year invites a sentence about the paperwork behind it, and the engine wrote exactly this one.

verdicts.finding: The published series covers producers; nothing in it is about their suppliers or contractors.
verdicts.temptation_note: A record year in a sector reads as a good year for everyone near it, which is the reading a small-business audience is owed and the evidence does not carry.

verdicts.finding: The series is national and corroborated, so the level the reading is asserted at looked available.
